problem.title: Vipermonkey/ cannot import "from logger import log" and "from core.meta import get_metadata.exif" error. How can I solve them?
problem.description: When I run the command python vmonkey.py -f C:\Users\X\Desktop\Example.docx , I get the following error. How can I solve it? C:\Users\X\ViperMonkey-master\vipermonkey>python vmonkey.py -f C:\Users\X\Desktop\Example.docx Traceback (most recent call last): File "C:\Users\X\ViperMonkey-master\vipermonkey\vmonkey.py", line 44, in <module> from core.meta import get_metadata_exif File "C:\Users\X\ViperMonkey-master\vipermonkey\core\__init__.py", line 102, in <module> from logger import log ImportError
